verdicts.reason: Both banners look almost identical and both are broken. The white frame panel sits off-centre on the left, and the text column spills past the panel's right edge. 'J'adore Paris' breaks out through the top of the frame. The decorative rules have come loose from their text and float as random lines, including one alone at the far left edge. The illustration is broken into scattered pieces with large empty areas between them (a bag and a jar stranded on the right), and the text is small with no real hierarchy. B only moves the bag and jar a few pixels, which doesn't change the result.
